rulebook_meta.name: Enterprise Architecture Standards (SAMPLE / PLACEHOLDER)
rulebook_meta.status: SIMULATED — replace with authoritative standards before real use
rulebook_meta.note: These rules are illustrative and structurally realistic so the conformance agent can be built and tested now. Wording is generic, not tied to any real organisation's standards.

rules.statement: All internet-facing services must sit behind the enterprise web application firewall (WAF).
rules.rationale: Provides a consistent perimeter control against common web attacks.
rules.check_hint: Look for any public/internet-facing endpoint in the design that is not routed through the WAF.

rules.statement: Data in transit must be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher for all service-to-service and client-to-service communication.
rules.rationale: Protects data confidentiality and integrity in transit.
rules.check_hint: Flag any data flow described as plaintext/unencrypted or using deprecated TLS versions.

rules.statement: Secrets (API keys, passwords, certificates) must be stored in the approved secrets manager, never in code or configuration files.
rules.rationale: Prevents credential leakage via source control or artifacts.
rules.check_hint: Flag any mention of credentials in config, environment files committed to repos, or hardcoded secrets.

rules.statement: All data stores must declare a data classification (public, internal, confidential, restricted).
rules.rationale: Classification drives the controls that must be applied.
rules.check_hint: Flag any datastore in the design with no stated classification.

rules.statement: Confidential or restricted data must be encrypted at rest.
rules.rationale: Protects sensitive data if storage media are compromised.
rules.check_hint: Flag confidential/restricted datastores that do not state encryption at rest.

rules.statement: Personal data must remain within approved hosting regions and must not be replicated outside them.
rules.check_hint: Flag any design that stores or replicates personal data outside the approved region(s).

rules.statement: Systems must integrate through published, versioned APIs rather than direct database access across system boundaries.
rules.check_hint: Flag any design where one system reads or writes another system's database directly.

rules.statement: All exposed APIs must enforce authentication and authorisation on every request.
rules.check_hint: Flag any API described as open/unauthenticated or lacking access control.

rules.statement: Business-critical services must be deployed across at least two availability zones.
rules.rationale: Avoids a single point of failure at the zone level.
rules.check_hint: Flag business-critical components deployed to a single zone/region with no redundancy.

rules.statement: Every service must define a documented backup and recovery approach with a stated recovery objective.
rules.rationale: Ensures data and service can be restored within agreed limits.
rules.check_hint: Flag services with no stated backup/recovery approach or recovery objective.

rules.statement: All services must emit centralised logs and health metrics to the enterprise monitoring platform.
rules.rationale: Enables operational visibility and incident response.
rules.check_hint: Flag services that do not send logs/metrics to central monitoring.

rules.statement: Components must use technologies from the approved technology standards catalogue; deviations require a recorded waiver.
rules.rationale: Controls sprawl and keeps the estate supportable.
rules.check_hint: Flag any technology/component not on the approved list and with no waiver reference.

rules.statement: Human access to systems must use enterprise single sign-on (SSO); local application accounts are not permitted for end users.
rules.rationale: Centralises identity and enables consistent access control.
rules.check_hint: Flag designs relying on local/standalone user accounts instead of enterprise SSO.

rules.statement: Service-to-service access must follow least privilege, granting only the permissions each service requires.
rules.rationale: Limits blast radius if a service is compromised.
rules.check_hint: Flag broad/admin-level or wildcard permissions granted to services.
